dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D planar mass from the mid-body region toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slightly irregular lateral margins with localized indentation on the left posterior flank near the peduncle transition.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-dark grey primary skin tone across the entire visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of fine, dark-pixel linear streaks and clusters concentrated along the central and posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and low-contrast boundaries between the primary grey baseline and the darker mottled markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast, fine-line rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) visible across the mid-to-posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive superficial linear scarring/rake marks distributed extensively over the dorsal ridge and lateral margins.
